items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: I never worked with anyone else but him as a drummer.

ctx.x: But, no, and you stayed with him quite a while on the drums then?

Well, I'd say about, I'd say about five years. I never worked with anyone else but him as a drummer. See? And then, shortly after that, my dad, they came back home to visit us. And whenever they come home off the road, they usually stay about two months. See? That's the only time our family saw our father and uncle, see? And they had new material. And then I told him, I said, these drums too coversome. I said, old man Manuel, when he gets through at night, he didn't have no case. He had a little bit of con cornet…
Let's see now. We were talking about, you played on excursions, boats you say, huh, some too, when you were playing drums even. And excursion trains.
